test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: An arc of length 33 π cm subtends an angle of 132° at the centre of the circle. Find the radius of the circle.
solution:
**Given:**

An arc of length 33 π cm subtends an angle of 132° at the centre of the circle.

**Concept used:**

Length of an arc = (θ)/(360°)×2πr

**Calculation:**

Let the radius of the circle be r

(132^o)/(360^o) times 2pi r=33pi

⇒ 8r = 360

⇒ r = 45

So, the radius of the circle = 45 cm

**∴ The radius of the circle is 45 cm.**
